test_cases.sparql:
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX lila: <http://lila-erc.eu/ontologies/lila/>
PREFIX elita: <http://w3id.org/elita/>
PREFIX marl: <http://www.gsi.upm.es/ontologies/marl/ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?italianWord (MAX(?polarityValue) AS ?maxPolarity) WHERE {
  GRAPH <http://liita.it/data> { ?italianLemma a ?italianLemmaType ; ontolex:writtenRep ?italianWord ; lila:hasPOS lila:noun . FILTER(?italianLemmaType IN (lila:Lemma, lila:Hypolemma)) }
  ?emotionEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma ; elita:HasEmotion elita:Disgusto .
  ?polarityEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma ; marl:hasPolarity ?polarityValueClass ; marl:hasPolarityValue ?polarityValueRaw . BIND(xsd:float(?polarityValueRaw) AS ?polarityValue)
  FILTER(?polarityValue > 0)
}
GROUP BY ?italianWord

PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>

PREFIX vartrans: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/vartrans#>

  FILTER(STR(?italianWord) = "cucchiaio")

test_cases.sparql:
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX lila: <http://lila-erc.eu/ontologies/lila/>
PREFIX vartrans: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/vartrans#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>

SELECT ?otherWord (SAMPLE(?sicilianWord) AS ?sharedSicilianWord) WHERE {
  GRAPH <http://liita.it/data> { ?italianLemma a ?italianLemmaType ; ontolex:writtenRep ?italianWord . FILTER(?italianLemmaType IN (lila:Lemma, lila:Hypolemma)) }
  FILTER(STR(?italianWord) = "bambino")
  ?sicEntryIt ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma ; vartrans:translatableAs ?sicEntry .
  ?sicEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?sicilianLemma .
  ?sicilianLemma dcterms:isPartOf <http://liita.it/data/id/DialettoSiciliano/lemma/LemmaBank> ; ontolex:writtenRep ?sicilianWord .
  ?otherSicLemma dcterms:isPartOf <http://liita.it/data/id/DialettoSiciliano/lemma/LemmaBank> ; ontolex:writtenRep ?otherSicWr . FILTER(STR(?otherSicWr) = STR(?sicilianWord))
  ?otherSicEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?otherSicLemma .
  ?otherEntryIt vartrans:translatableAs ?otherSicEntry ; ontolex:canonicalForm ?otherLemma .
  GRAPH <http://liita.it/data> { ?otherLemma a ?otherLemmaType ; ontolex:writtenRep ?otherWord . FILTER(?otherLemmaType IN (lila:Lemma, lila:Hypolemma)) }
  FILTER(?otherLemma != ?italianLemma)
}
GROUP BY ?otherWord
test_cases.note: the translation relation is used twice, from two Italian lemmas to the same Sicilian entry

test_cases.sparql:
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX lila: <http://lila-erc.eu/ontologies/lila/>
PREFIX elita: <http://w3id.org/elita/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?italianWord (COUNT(DISTINCT ?emotion) AS ?count) WHERE {
  GRAPH <http://liita.it/data> { ?italianLemma a ?italianLemmaType ; ontolex:writtenRep ?italianWord . FILTER(?italianLemmaType IN (lila:Lemma, lila:Hypolemma)) }
  ?emotionEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma ; elita:HasEmotion ?emotion . ?emotion rdfs:label ?emotionLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?italianWord
HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?emotion) > 6)
ORDER BY DESC(?count)

test_cases.sparql:
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX lila: <http://lila-erc.eu/ontologies/lila/>
PREFIX elita: <http://w3id.org/elita/>
PREFIX marl: <http://www.gsi.upm.es/ontologies/marl/ns#>
PREFIX vartrans: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/vartrans#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?italianWord (SAMPLE(?definition) AS ?exampleDefinition) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?emotion) AS ?emotionCount)
  (MAX(?polarityValue) AS ?maxPolarity) (SAMPLE(?sicilianWord) AS ?exampleSicilian) (SAMPLE(?parmigianoWord) AS ?exampleParmigiano)
WHERE {
  # 1. CompL-it: senses whose definition mentions 'sentimento' (regex with flags: required inside SERVICE)
  SERVICE <https://klab.ilc.cnr.it/graphdb-compl-it/> {
    ?word ontolex:sense ?sense .
    ?sense skos:definition ?definition .
    FILTER(REGEX(STR(?definition), "dolore", "i"))
  }
  # 2. LiITA: the CompL-it word is linked to an Italian lemma (or hypolemma)
  ?word ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma .
  GRAPH <http://liita.it/data> {
    ?italianLemma a ?lemmaType ; ontolex:writtenRep ?italianWord .
    FILTER(?lemmaType IN (lila:Lemma, lila:Hypolemma))
  }
  # 3. ELIta: emotions of the lemma
  ?emotionEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma ; elita:HasEmotion ?emotion .
  ?emotion rdfs:label ?emotionLabel .
  # 4. Sentix: polarity of the lemma
  ?polarityEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma ; marl:hasPolarity ?polarityClass ; marl:hasPolarityValue ?polarityRaw .
  BIND(xsd:float(?polarityRaw) AS ?polarityValue)
  # 5. Sicilian translation
  ?sicEntryIt ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma ; vartrans:translatableAs ?sicEntry .
  ?sicEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?sicilianLemma .
  ?sicilianLemma dcterms:isPartOf <http://liita.it/data/id/DialettoSiciliano/lemma/LemmaBank> ;
                 ontolex:writtenRep ?sicilianWord .
  # 6. Parmigiano translation
  ?parEntryIt ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma ; vartrans:translatableAs ?parEntry .
  ?parEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?parmigianoLemma .
  ?parmigianoLemma dcterms:isPartOf <http://liita.it/data/id/DialettoParmigiano/lemma/LemmaBank> ;
                   ontolex:writtenRep ?parmigianoWord .
}
GROUP BY ?italianWord
ORDER BY ?italianWord
test_cases.note: all six resources used by the systems: CompL-it, LiITA, ELIta, Sentix, Sicilian, Parmigiano. Reworded 2026-11-09 to one row per word (the full superquery.rq returns 310 cartesian rows for 21 words); SAMPLE columns are secondary (arbitrary values). Keyword changed 2026-11-09 from 'sentimento' (seed word of NL2SPARQL example 'hyponyms of sentimento ... polarity and translations'); superquery.rq keeps 'sentimento' as the thesis showcase. 15 words; 'sollevare' (relieve from pain) is the only off-field match

test_cases.sparql:
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX lila: <http://lila-erc.eu/ontologies/lila/>
PREFIX elita: <http://w3id.org/elita/>
PREFIX marl: <http://www.gsi.upm.es/ontologies/marl/ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?italianWord (MIN(?polarityValue) AS ?minPolarity) WHERE {
  GRAPH <http://liita.it/data> { ?italianLemma a ?italianLemmaType ; ontolex:writtenRep ?italianWord . FILTER(?italianLemmaType IN (lila:Lemma, lila:Hypolemma)) }
  ?emotionEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma ; elita:HasEmotion elita:Tristezza .
  ?polarityEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma ; marl:hasPolarity ?polarityValueClass ; marl:hasPolarityValue ?polarityValueRaw . BIND(xsd:float(?polarityValueRaw) AS ?polarityValue)
}
GROUP BY ?italianWord
HAVING (MIN(?polarityValue) > 0)
